title: Supported boundary equation with shared categorical interfaces
statement: For categories A,C,D, U:A→D, R,E:C→D, pi:R→E, g:P→Q in A, s:U(Q)→R(K), f:K→J, b:J→W and v:U(P)→E(W), supportedBoundaryEquation(U,R,E,pi,g,s,f,b,v) means U(g)≫s≫pi(K)≫E(f)≫E(b)=v. The wrapper changes no mathematical condition and explicitly shares the category instances of this finite arrow equation.

    (U : A ⥤ D) (R E : C ⥤ D) (pi : R ⟶ E)
